conclusion: law4-energy-v8 (exact zero-SVD Renyi-2 erank_2 > 1.6 gated 0-NS Frob-MP m^0.25 on G + 0-NS Critic Frob-MP m^0.25) scored 13/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1, delivering the sharpest grid100 (prec=0.9917, ctr=0.0658) and vector_unequal_width (hq=0.9985, cov=0.1431) of all tested optimizers while skipping 2D NS on well-conditioned generator layers.
